summary: Re-tested AI Image Generator end-to-end after fix to AiImageRequest.style max_length (60→200). Both regression curl and full UI E2E flow PASS. Default 70-char style is now accepted, async job lifecycle completes cleanly, no StructuredErrorCard appears, and the AI counter in the asset library bumps (14 AI → 15 AI) confirming onGenerated callback refresh worked. Total wall-clock for one low/1 image: ~12s.
action_items: (Optional, carried from iter19) Add a Pydantic validation_error → StructuredErrorCard mapper at the route layer so future field-length / type errors surface a user-friendly message instead of generic 'Unexpected error / Request failed.'

(Optional, carried from iter19) Add a startup janitor that marks ai_image_jobs stuck in pending/processing older than N minutes as 'failed' — in-process _ai_image_tasks set can orphan jobs across backend restarts.
(Optional, carried from iter19) /app/backend/routers/media.py is ~1298 lines — split into media/{upload,edit,ai_image,video,export,assets}.py when convenient.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified at /app/backend/routers/media.py:317 — style: Optional[constr(max_length=200)] (was 60). Curl with the full 70-char default returns 202 in <100ms.
Frontend default in /app/frontend/src/pages/dashboard/aiads/MediaStudio.jsx:124 unchanged (70 chars) and now within constraint.

success_rate.backend: 100% — POST /api/media/ai-image with default style returns 202 {job_id, status:'pending'}.
success_rate.frontend: 100% — login → Promotions → Media → AI Images → Generate 1 Image: progress card appears <0.05s, status label 'Queued…' → 'Generating image…', no error card, progress card clears in ~12s, button back to 'Generate 1 Image', asset library AI counter increments (14 → 15).

seed_data_creation: One new AI-generated asset added during the E2E run (folder 'Promotions', prompt 'Plate of beignets with powdered sugar', source='ai_image').
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI image async-job + polling UI is fully working end-to-end. Backend (max_length=200) and frontend (70-char default) are now consistent. No outstanding blockers on this feature. Remaining items are non-blocking enhancements (Pydantic-error → StructuredError mapper, stuck-job janitor, media.py file split). The 404 console resources observed during testing are unrelated to this flow (a preloaded customer asset).
rca of the issue: Previous iteration (19) RCA: schema/UI drift — backend declared style max_length=60 but the FE default literal was 70 chars, so any submit with default returned 422 before a job was enqueued. Fix applied in iteration 20 review: routers/media.py:317 changed to constr(max_length=200). Verified both via curl (HTTP 202) and via Playwright UI E2E (progress card appears, completes in ~12s, no error card).
